description.en-US: Benson's account of 1913 of his road from the Anglican priesthood (the son of an Archbishop of Canterbury) to the Catholic Church in 1903: the Church of England as he knew it, the Mirfield years, his doubts and his reception at Woodchester, and what the Church has been to him since.
description.pt-BR: O relato de Benson (1913) do seu caminho do sacerdócio anglicano (filho de um arcebispo de Cantuária) à Igreja Católica em 1903: a Igreja da Inglaterra como a conheceu, os anos de Mirfield, suas dúvidas e a recepção em Woodchester, e o que a Igreja tem sido para ele desde então.

sources.edition: Confessions of a Convert (London: Longmans, Green, 1913), Internet Archive full-text OCR (confessionsofaco00bensuoft).
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Mgr. Robert Hugh Benson died in 1914 and the edition is of 1913, so the text is public domain.
